# Assess 1: Assessor Selection (A-1)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | Assess (A), system level |
| Phases | Engineering and Manufacturing Development (PH-EMD) (primary) |
| Depends on | Select 6: Plan Review and Approval (S-6) |
| Inputs | System Security Plan (ART-SSP), Organizational risk context (ART-ORG-CONTEXT), Organizational policy and Prepare-step guidance (EXT-ORG-POLICY), Product material (EXT-PRODUCT) |
| Outputs | — |
| Writes facts | — |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: AODR (PER-AODR) · A: AO (PER-AO) · C: Component CIO (PER-CIO), Component CISO (PER-CISO), Privacy (PER-PRIV) · I: PM/SO (PER-PM), SCA (PER-SCA) · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |
| Persona cards | [AODR (PER-AODR)](../../personas/PER-AODR.md), [AO (PER-AO)](../../personas/PER-AO.md), [Component CIO (PER-CIO)](../../personas/PER-CIO.md), [Component CISO (PER-CISO)](../../personas/PER-CISO.md), [Privacy (PER-PRIV)](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md) |

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** Run `uv run rmf status <run>`: A-1 is the next action, and
   S-6 is done or out of scope.
   Entry criteria (from `framework/tasks/A.yaml`):
   - Security plan approved (S-6).
   If one is not met, stop and journal a NOTE (`00-run-protocol.md`, stop conditions). Why:
   the task builds on those results, and working around a gap leaves claims nobody can
   trace.
2. **Read the inputs** listed in `## Inputs`, and the passages in `## Citations` that say
   what A-1 must achieve. The purpose in the header states the outcome.
   A-1 feeds RV-TRR (Test Readiness Review, review); what it
   records must be ready for that event.
   Why: the playbook is generic, so the inputs and the cited text set the content.
3. **Interview** following `_shared/interviewing.md` (and `_shared/hybrid-mode.md` in a
   `hybrid` run). Start with the responsible (R) personas in `## Interviews`. Take the
   questions from each persona card's `## Question bank by step` for step A
   (Assess) and point them at what the exit criteria in `## Done when` need and the
   inputs leave open.
   Write at least 1 interview file(s) with `task: A-1`.
   Why: answers are the evidence that artifacts cite (`INT-###.A#`).
4. **Record the result.** A-1 has no artifact output: its record is the interview
   files, which must hold what the exit criteria in `## Done when` name, so later tasks
   can cite the answers. When a persona makes a decision, also journal a DECISION entry
   (`_shared/journaling-and-lessons.md`).
5. **Leave `facts.yaml` alone.** A-1 writes no facts (INV-4).
6. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task A-1`,
   until 0 errors (INV-6).
7. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT (`## Journal and lessons`).

## Interviews

| Persona | Role | Interview |
|---|---|---|
| PER-AODR (Authorizing Official Designated Representative) | R | start here |
| PER-AO (Authorizing Official) | A | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-CIO (DoD Component Chief Information Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-CISO (DoD Component Chief Information Security Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-PRIV (Component Privacy Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |

At least 1 interview(s) with `task: A-1`. Never make a persona answer
outside its role; ask the persona who would know, or record an assumption.

## Inputs

- ART-SSP (System Security Plan): `artifacts/ART-SSP.md`, `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml`, `artifacts/data/ssp-records.yaml`, `artifacts/data/plan-reviews.yaml`, `artifacts/data/scrm-plan.yaml`
- ART-ORG-CONTEXT (Organizational risk context): `artifacts/ART-ORG-CONTEXT.md`, `artifacts/data/org-context.yaml`, `artifacts/data/scrm-org.yaml`
- EXT-ORG-POLICY (Organizational policy and Prepare-step guidance): the product directory, when the fork supplies it there;
  otherwise ask the responsible persona, and record an assumption for what nobody can
  answer.
- EXT-PRODUCT (Product material): files in the run's product directory, cited as
  `product/<path>#<anchor>`.
- Only these: do not open other run files (`00-run-protocol.md`, step 4).

## Outputs

A-1 has no artifact output; the interviews (and any journal DECISION) are its record.

## Facts

A-1 writes no facts.

## Done when

- An assessor or assessment team is selected, with the appropriate level of independence (DoDI 8510.01 Table 5 outcome).
- The selected SCA and the basis for its independence are recorded (interview and journal DECISION), ready for the SAP team (A-2).
- The CISO has verified each assessor's qualification, and the AO has determined the degree of independence required; A-2 records both in sap.yaml (ATEAM-001, ASMT-007), so `--task A-1` cannot judge them, and the A-1 interviews must hold them for A-2 to cite.
- sap.yaml assessor_independence.consulted names the CIO, the senior agency official for privacy and the senior agency information security officer the AO consults on assessor independence, and the Office of the Inspector General where the organization has one (INDEP-001, judged once A-2 writes sap.yaml).
- At least 1 interview(s) with `task: A-1`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task A-1` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task A-1`, naming what the outputs now hold.
- A fix that took more than one `rmf check` round gets a RETRY entry and a lesson
  (`_shared/journaling-and-lessons.md`).
